title: Searchlight Pictures Marketing EVP Michelle Hooper Exits Studio
content:
ByPayton Turkeltaub

Michelle Hooper is leavingSearchlight Picturesas executive vice president of marketing after two decades with the company.

Since joining in 2006, Hooper’s work on publicity, awards and creative marketing helped earn the studio nearly 200 Oscar nominations and more than 130 Golden Globe nominations. Of those 200, Searchlight took home 49 wins, including best picture winners “Nomadland,” “The Shape of Water,” “Birdman,” “12 Years a Slave” and “Slumdog Millionaire.” Searchlight also received best picture nominations at the Golden Globes for the aforementioned titles, in addition to 15 others.

This awards season, Hooper was leading campaigns for “Wild Horse Nine” and “Behemonth!,” among other titles.

“She’s a stellar leader for her creative insights and keen ability to read a film for where it fits in the zeitgeist, in turn setting her team up for wide-reaching success,” said a longtime colleague. “But she’s also an equally formidable collaborator, one who can close a campaign with all the insights gained from keeping her ear to the ground and hearing feedback in real time. It’s a loss for the studio, but I guarantee you it will be another’s gain.”

Earlier in her career, Hooper worked at CBS Entertainment as the director of entertainment communications and aided in the “Survivor” publicity strategy; she also spent four years at Fox Broadcast as the company’s VP of entertainment publicity, where she worked on campaigns for shows like “The Simpsons,” “Arrested Development” and “American Idol.”

Hooper was featured inVariety’s2025 Women’s Impact Reportalongside fellow Searchlight executives Rebecca Kearey, DanTram Nguyen and Katie Goodson-Thomas, whose work to ensure the studio had a stellar year at the Oscars was highlighted.

“The team’s marketing mojo led to 10 Academy Award nominations for ‘A Complete Unknown’ and ‘A Real Pain,’ including a best supporting actor win for Kieran Culkin’s performance in the Jesse Eisenberg film,” wroteVariety.

In a joint statement, the team explained that Searchlight’s adventurous choices and deep filmmaker relationships help the company weather the challenges of the business by “trusting [that] audiences still want films that entertain, challenge and provoke.”
title_zh: 搜尋光影業(Searchlight Pictures)行銷執行副總裁米歇爾·胡普(Michelle Hooper)離開了公司。
content_zh:
由佩頓·圖克塔布(Payton Turkeltaub)報導

米歇爾·霍普(Michelle Hooper)在擔任Searchlight Pictures的行銷執行副總裁二十年後，將離開公司。

自2006年加入以來，霍普在公關、獎項及創意行銷方面的工作，幫助這家影業公司獲得了近200項奧斯卡提名和超過130項金球獎提名。在這200項提名中，Searchlight共獲得49項獎項，包括最佳影片獎得主《游牧人生(Nomadland)》、《水形物語(The Shape of Water)》、《鳥人(Birdman)》、《為奴十二年(12 Years a Slave)》和《貧民百萬富翁(Slumdog Millionaire)》。此外，Searchlight在金球獎中也為上述影片及其他15部作品獲得最佳影片提名。

在本屆獎季中，霍普負責《野馬九號(Wild Horse Nine)》和《巨獸(Behemonth!)》等影片的行銷活動。

一位長期同事表示：“她是一位出色的領導者，擁有創意洞察力和敏銳的能力，能夠判斷一部電影在當代文化中的位置，從而使她的團隊獲得廣泛的成功。但她同樣也是一位強大的合作者，能夠在實時聆聽反饋的過程中，運用獲得的洞察力來結束一個行銷活動。這對影業來說是一大損失，但我保證這將是其他公司的收穫。”

在她的職業生涯早期，霍普曾在CBS娛樂擔任娛樂傳播總監，協助制定《生存者(Survivor)》的公關策略；她還在福斯廣播公司擔任娛樂公關副總裁四年，負責《辛普森一家(The Simpsons)》、《被捕的發展(Arrested Development)》和《美國偶像(American Idol)》等節目的行銷活動。

霍普在《綜藝(Variety)》的2025年女性影響力報告中被列入，與Searchlight的其他高層如瑞貝卡·基瑞(Rebecca Kearey)、丹·特拉姆·阮(Dan Tram Nguyen)和凱蒂·古德森·托馬斯(Katie Goodson-Thomas)一同被提及，他們的工作確保了影業在奧斯卡獲得了卓越的表現。

《綜藝(Variety)》寫道：“團隊的行銷魔力為《完全陌生人(A Complete Unknown)》和《真實的痛苦(A Real Pain)》帶來了10項奧斯卡提名，包括基蘭·庫克林(Kieran Culkin)在傑西·艾森伯格(Jesse Eisenberg)電影中的表現獲得最佳男配角獎。”

在一份聯合聲明中，團隊解釋說，Searchlight的冒險選擇和深厚的導演關係幫助公司應對業務挑戰，因為“相信觀眾仍然渴望娛樂、挑戰和激發思考的電影。”
